name: shared32
description: Shared Q/K selection with half of the 64 rotary pairs per head (the 32 lowest-damage pairs by pooled damage_q + damage_k, the same set on Q and K; a superset of shared22) replaced by learned means after QK-RMSNorm and before RoPE; nothing exempt. Same recipe as the no-exemption shared22 study (s22_all) so the two are directly comparable. Arms: trained means, and the same 32 pairs zeroed at inference (zeros swap). User-assigned 21 November 2026, 18 GPU-hours approved, trainer unchanged.
